items.description: Add `/claude:plugin reload` and the sessionful predicate (.planning/research/HEADLESS-RELOAD.md, decisions 1-4). A single named predicate `acceptsLaterCommands(ctx)` returns `ctx.hasUI`, with the reasoning in its doc comment. The subcommand runs `ctx.reload()` only when the predicate is true (TUI and RPC). In a one-shot host it refuses with a short usage message, and help and completions leave it out there. The reload hint text follows the same predicate: no hint in a one-shot host, while the JSON and RPC payload keeps `needsReload`. The wording of every user-facing instruction to reload goes through one place: `/reload` when the host has a native `/reload` (a single named predicate, true only for the TUI, documented as a Pi fact), and `/claude:plugin reload` in other sessionful hosts. Cover every site listed in the note. Include cucumber scenarios for TUI, RPC and one-shot that fail without the change, unit tests at 100% direct coverage, docs (output catalog, README command list, the relevant compatibility pages), a decision ID in PROJECT.md, and a CHANGELOG parent line in the SUMMARY.

RPC tests reload instead of starting a new session (.planning/research/HEADLESS-RELOAD.md, decision 5). Add an RPC harness step that sends `/claude:plugin reload` (it depends on the subcommand from the sibling item). Audit every RPC step that calls `startSession` / `new_session` (639 "the user starts a new pi session" uses in 92 feature files, plus the library callers the note lists). Switch the ones that only stand in for a reload to the reload step. Keep the ones that test a new session: SessionStart `clear`, SessionEnd hooks, an empty conversation, or the shared Pi reset between scenarios. Fix the `features/lib/pi-commands.ts:162` comment. Both cucumber profiles must stay green, and the audit result (counts per category, with file lists) goes in the SUMMARY.
